title: IBM OM standard-crossbar deployment mismatch and on-chip recovery versus DRN
hypothesis: Because the standard crossbar computes signed q=a-r matrix-vector products and places ReLU digitally, its direct fixed-teacher deployment loss will be smaller than the four-device full-G passive DRN loss on the matched Winsorized IBM OM control. Five fixed epochs of deterministic-codebook QAT will further reduce the stochastic P&V deficit; consequently one epoch of matched same-array pulse-Adam will provide a smaller absolute gain than in the DRN, while the predeclared floor test determines whether it is still needed after QAT.
motivation: The recent exploratory DRN endpoint cohort used a 94.14% recovered source, produced a 92.02% ideal requested-remap control, fell to 63.16% mean persistent accuracy, and recovered to 93.065% with one fixed epoch of open-loop Adam; the common ReLU teacher scores 97.36%. This study changes the architecture, not the source task: the same teacher, bias-free logical 784-50-10 dimensions, and two-layer role are implemented as a 512-limited standard analog crossbar, digital ReLU, and a second standard analog crossbar. The crossbar starts from the exact teacher tensors, whereas the pinned DRN source is its separately recovered physical checkpoint, so the analysis compares each architecture's source-to-deployment loss and does not claim an identical trained weight tensor. The ladder separates direct mapping, exact continuous per-cell HWA, deterministic 128-pulse-codebook QAT, stochastic P&V, and same-array recovery. The primary six Winsorized arms retain the DRN control's repaired IBM OM treatment, assignment 87004, endpoint labels 89402-89405, data order, teacher-KL objective, coordinate-equivalent recovery rate, 64-pulse recovery cap, and fixed-final checkpoints. Two native-bound QAT arms test whether the DRN-specific Winsorization changes the conclusion, but are not treated as a bound-matched architecture comparison.

arms.description: Exact teacher mapping followed by bound-matched stochastic P&V, with apparent-forward and hidden-persistent metrics and no off-chip or on-chip updates.
Five fixed epochs exposed to exact per-cell continuous support clamps, followed by apparent-forward P&V, a hidden-persistent diagnostic, and no on-chip updates.
Five fixed epochs of deterministic 128-pulse-codebook QAT, followed by apparent-forward P&V, a hidden-persistent diagnostic, and no on-chip updates; primary HWA-only baseline.
The identical fixed-final QAT target plus one fixed epoch of coordinate-matched open-loop pulse-Adam on both crossbar layers, followed by fresh-assignment transfer.
The identical fixed-final QAT target with recovery pulses allowed only in the 784-to-50 crossbar.
The identical fixed-final QAT target with recovery pulses allowed only in the 50-to-10 crossbar.
Deterministic-codebook QAT under AIHWKit-native sampled bounds, followed by P&V and no recovery; sensitivity control only.
The identical native-bound fixed-final QAT target with full pulse-Adam recovery and fresh-assignment transfer; sensitivity control only.

completion_criteria: All eight declared configs complete exactly once, and every run records the frozen teacher SHA-256, AIHWKit 1.1.0 sampler receipt, effective-population fingerprint, 512-limited tile layout, assignment seed, and four endpoint seeds.

The direct, continuous-HWA, and QAT arms have identical source-requested and source-population hashes within the Winsorized treatment. All four Winsorized QAT arms have identical fixed-final off-chip master and realized-target hashes, and the QAT-frozen and QAT-on-chip arms have identical per-endpoint P0 persistent and apparent hashes. The two native QAT arms satisfy the same parity checks within native bounds; any mismatch invalidates the paired comparison.

Every arm reports the floating teacher, source per-cell support-clamped continuous envelope, source 128-pulse deterministic codebook, post-off-chip deployment target, and stochastic 128-pulse P&V endpoint metrics before interpreting recovery.

Continuous HWA and deterministic QAT each run exactly five MNIST epochs from the same source, batch size 16, data seed 42, teacher-KL, Adam betas 0.9/0.999, logical rates [1e-4, 1e-4], q-shadow bounds [-1,1], straight-through exposed states, and fixed final epoch without validation or test selection. Continuous HWA exposes exact support clamps; QAT exposes exact per-cell deterministic codebook states. Neither performs stochastic writes or persistent updates during off-chip training.

The recovery arms use exactly one full MNIST epoch, batch size 16, data seed 42, teacher-KL, Adam betas 0.9/0.999, q-coordinate learning rates 6e-5, a 64-pulse per-cell cap, no verify reads during recovery, and the fixed final epoch without validation or test selection.

The matched full-recovery and native full-recovery arms reprogram their named final hidden-persistent q states onto untouched assignments 87005, 87006, and 87007, with four programming seeds per assignment, and report per-assignment apparent-forward accuracy, hidden-persistent diagnostics, and programming cost.

The word needed is evaluated only from the matched Winsorized QAT-frozen P0 endpoints and the byte-matched QAT-plus-on-chip endpoints after the target and P0 parity audit. Direct-map and continuous-HWA arms cannot establish necessity.

The direct DRN comparison is limited to the six Winsorized arms and the pinned exploratory DRN receipt; the native-bound sensitivity arms are never presented as a matched architecture comparison. Even under Winsorization, label absolute crossbar-versus-DRN accuracy as an architecture-specific outcome because the crossbar forward uses apparent q while the pinned DRN receipt reports persistent physical conductances.
analysis_plan: For each endpoint, report teacher accuracy, continuous-envelope accuracy, deterministic-codebook accuracy, P0 apparent-forward and hidden-persistent accuracy, fixed-final apparent-forward and hidden-persistent accuracy, KL, teacher agreement, prediction flips, programming pulses, recovery pulses by layer, changed cells, cap hits, and fresh-transfer accuracy where applicable.

First compare direct mapping, continuous HWA, and deterministic QAT at their exact realized pre-write targets and their apparent-forward P0 endpoints to separate support loss, codebook loss, and stochastic programming loss. Keep hidden-persistent endpoints beside them as state-estimation diagnostics. Off-chip adaptation gains are not on-chip gains.

Primary on-chip importance measures use the QAT-only apparent-forward baseline: the paired mean P0-to-fixed-final accuracy gain and the mean fraction of the QAT-source-to-P0 accuracy gap closed. Report all four endpoint values and do not pool examples across endpoints.

Compare the matched crossbar P0 and fixed-final accuracies endpoint-wise with the pinned DRN P0 values [62.49, 63.74, 66.29, 60.12]% and DRN open-loop-Adam values [93.62, 92.83, 92.74, 93.07]%. Report direct crossbar loss from its 97.36% exact-teacher source, QAT stochastic-write loss from its own exact fixed-final codebook target, and DRN loss from both its 94.14% recovered source and 92.02% ideal requested-remap control; preserve that endpoint labels refer to stochastic realizations on topology-specific populations, not shared physical cells.
Use input-only and output-only paired gains and pulse counts to localize which layer accounts for recovery. Do not infer additivity because nonlinear interaction makes the two ablations dependent.

Compare same-array apparent-forward fixed-final accuracy with per-assignment fresh-transfer apparent accuracy to separate task recovery from assignment-specific compensation. Treat multiple programming seeds within one assignment as repeated writes, not independent arrays.

Treat an absolute mean gain below 1 percentage point with every absolute endpoint gain below 2 points as negligible for this protocol; treat a larger change as material and report its sign, but reserve the word needed for a result whose matched QAT-frozen mean misses the predeclared 90% accuracy floor and whose byte-matched QAT-plus-recovery mean crosses it.
Report native versus Winsorized results as bound-treatment sensitivity and retain the model-based, repaired-defect, no-read-noise, no-retention, no-line-resistance, and no-absolute-power limitations.
